name: Port Forwarding & SSH Tunneling
description: Ability to forward ports and create SSH tunnels to access services on internal networks through compromised hosts. Covers local and remote port forwarding, dynamic SOCKS proxying via SSH, and use of tools like Chisel, plink, and socat for non-SSH environments.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to port forwarding or tunneling techniques

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the concepts of port forwarding and tunneling for network pivoting
evidence: Can explain local vs. remote port forwarding and dynamic SOCKS proxying
Understands why pivoting is needed to reach segmented networks
Knows the basic SSH flags for tunneling (-L, -R, -D)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Sets up basic port forwards and SSH tunnels under supervision
evidence: Creates SSH local and remote port forwards to access internal services
Sets up dynamic SOCKS proxies via SSH for proxychains use
Uses Chisel or socat for port forwarding when SSH is unavailable
Documents tunnel configurations and access paths under review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently establishes reliable tunnels to reach segmented networks during engagements
evidence: Plans and deploys tunneling infrastructure for multi-hop network access
Selects the appropriate tunneling tool based on environment constraints
Maintains stable tunnels throughout engagements with reconnection handling
Documents all active tunnels and their purpose for engagement tracking

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Creates complex tunneling architectures; handles constrained environments; mentors others
evidence: Builds multi-hop tunnel chains through multiple pivot hosts
Tunnels through restrictive firewalls using allowed protocols (HTTP, DNS)
Optimizes tunnel performance for large data transfers or interactive sessions
Mentors junior staff on tunneling techniques and troubleshooting

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines tunneling methodology; develops custom tunneling tools; trains teams
evidence: Authored the lab's pivoting and tunneling standard methodology
Develops custom tunneling tools for specialized environments
Published research on tunneling techniques or network evasion
Trains teams on advanced tunneling strategy and architecture

assessment_methods.description: From an initial foothold, establish tunnels to access services on two non-adjacent network segments in a lab environment
Given a restrictive firewall configuration, identify and implement a viable tunneling approach to reach an internal target
